prompts.display_text: Pin a country where a new temple was dedicated from 2016 through 2018 (not counting rededications).
prompts.text_original: Pin a country where a new temple was dedicated from 2016 through 2018 (not counting rededications).
prompts.summary: From 2016 through 2018, new temples were dedicated in Sapporo, Japan (2016), Paris, France (2017), Concepcion, Chile (2018) and Barranquilla, Colombia (2018), alongside eight in the United States. Paris was the first temple in France.

answers.name: United States of America
answers.fact: Cedar City Utah, 2017; Fort Collins Colorado, 2016; Hartford Connecticut, 2016; and 5 more.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country whose second dedicated temple was dedicated in 2010 or later.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country whose second dedicated temple was dedicated in 2010 or later.
prompts.citation: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org chronology and milestones, read 27 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: A country's second temple, counting only temples now in operation, usually means the Church there has outgrown one temple. New Zealand's second, in Auckland, was dedicated on 13 April 2025, the latest in this set.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country that Church leaders formally opened to missionaries with a prayer, 1850-1881.
prompts.text_original: A country that, per its Church Global Histories chronology, an apostle or missionary formally dedicated for the preaching of the gospel between 1850 and 1881.
prompts.citation: Church Global Histories chronologies: France, Italy, Switzerland, South Africa, Sweden, Mexico
prompts.note: Israel does not count: the 1873 Mount of Olives prayer was for the gathering of the Jews, not a dedication for preaching.
prompts.summary: Opening a new land often began with a prayer of dedication. Global Histories record John Taylor dedicating France and Lorenzo Snow dedicating Italy in 1850, Snow dedicating Switzerland in 1851, missionaries on Lion's Head above Cape Town in 1853, Sweden in 1857 and Moses Thatcher in Mexico in 1880-81.

answers.name: France
answers.fact: 1850: John Taylor dedicated France for missionary work.

answers.name: Italy
answers.fact: 1850: Lorenzo Snow, T. B. H. Stenhouse and Jabez Woodard dedicated Italy.

answers.name: Mexico
answers.fact: 1880-81: Moses Thatcher dedicated Mexico for missionary work.

answers.name: Sweden
answers.fact: 1857: Apostle Ezra T. Benson and mission leaders dedicated Sweden for preaching.

answers.name: South Africa
answers.fact: 1853: missionaries dedicated the land on Lion's Head above Cape Town.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country named in the Church's 2022 World Food Programme or 2023 or 2026 UNICEF gifts
prompts.text_original: The Church gave US$32 million to the World Food Programme in September 2022, and US$10 million (August 2023) and US$25 million (May 2026) to UNICEF for mothers and children. A country named as receiving help from one of these three gifts.
prompts.citation: Newsroom 2022 WFP; Church News 2023-08-17; Church News 2026-05-20
prompts.note: Somaliland is scored as part of Somalia.
prompts.summary: In 2022 the Church gave the World Food Programme US$32 million for hunger in nine countries from Afghanistan to Yemen. UNICEF received US$10 million in 2023 for mothers and children in four countries and US$25 million in 2026 for child nutrition in five more.

answers.name: Somalia
answers.fact: WFP 2022 food aid. The gift went to Somalia, which this map splits; a Somaliland pin scores as Somalia.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country Russell M. Nelson dedicated for the preaching of the gospel in September 2010
prompts.text_original: In September 2010 Elder Russell M. Nelson of the Quorum of the Twelve traveled through the former Yugoslavia and dedicated six lands for the preaching of the gospel. A country he dedicated on that trip.
prompts.summary: In one September 2010 journey Russell M. Nelson, then an Apostle, offered dedicatory prayers in six lands of the former Yugoslavia: Croatia, Slovenia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Kosovo and Macedonia. It was one of many such prayers he offered across Eastern Europe and Central Asia.

answers.name: North Macedonia
answers.fact: Dedicated for preaching in September 2010, then called Macedonia.
